metas.name: 1 · ★ 5.3 · 1990 · Sergeant Körmy and the Marshal's Staff
metas.description: The colonel's wife's tin pints need to be cleaned up, and Sergeant First Class Körmy tasks two privates to do so.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 4.8 · 1991 · Sergeant Körmy and the Underwater Vehicles
metas.description: Sergeant Friman is developing an automatic submarine detector that piques the interest of both, Swedish and Russian spies.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 4.6 · 1992 · Sergeant Körmy and the South Pacific
metas.description: The Minister of Defence asks sergeant Körmy to take part in operation, where the United States and Russia are to hand over their nuclear weapons launch equipment and codes to neutral Finland.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 4.6 · 1994 · Sergeant Körmy: My Struggle
metas.description: Relations between Sweden and Finland come to near breaking point. When further negotiations led by President Mara fail, Sergeant Körmy interferes in the course of events.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 4.2 · 1997 · Sergeant Körmy and the Double Trigger
metas.description: New takeover plans and Russian art thief looking for Mannerheim's portraits keep Sergeant Körmy busy.
